node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate negative two-loop product-to-q weld
node.closure: rank-three Mobius product reconstruction and two scalar welds equivalent to the five common-K sum equations in the two-loop stratum
node.statement: In either negative two-loop skeleton, the five common-K product rows have rank exactly three and uniquely reconstruct the Mobius denominator B_2 projectively. For either loop anchor h and nonloop labels i,j, the sum equations are equivalent to the denominator-free weld q_i R(j)(h-i)(p_h-p_j)=q_j R(i)(h-j)(p_h-p_i). Two such welds against one fixed nonloop label are necessary and sufficient for all five common-K sum equations. The signed skeleton classification and complement fibers remain open.
